---
title: "Course Materials"
subtitle: "Open books, courses and tutorials"
---

All materials are websites you can read right away. The sources are on GitHub, so
you can copy and adapt them for your own course.

## Linear Algebra and Numerical Methods

A Quarto book on linear algebra with numerical methods in Python.

[Open the book](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/linalg-project/){.btn .btn-primary}
[Source](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/linalg-project){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## Python Crash Course

A short introduction to Python for mathematics students, made at Lund University and
based on Jan-Fredrik Olsen's lecture notes *"Don't panic"*.

[Open the course](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/crashcourse_python/){.btn .btn-primary}
[Source](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/crashcourse_python){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## Quarto Tutorial

How to write your own interactive teaching material with Quarto: websites, exercise
sheets, books and Python that runs in the browser. Three levels (example page,
getting started, tips & tricks) in five languages (German, English, Swedish,
Norwegian, Danish).

[Open the tutorial](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/Quarto-Tutorial/en/){.btn .btn-primary}
[Source](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/Quarto-Tutorial){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## Workshop materials

Hands-on material from the project's workshops, ready to reuse.

| Workshop | Content |
|---|---|
| [Creating Python-based tutorials with Quarto](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/workshop-python-tutorials-2025) (Bochum, 2025) | Setup, first `.qmd` documents, Python cells running in the browser |
| [AI feedback in learning management systems](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/workshop-ai-2025) (Bochum, 2025) | Example configurations for an AI math tutor |
| [Quarto workshop](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/workshop-quarto-2026) (Lund, 2026) | Multilingual websites, one source for many output formats, presentations |
